en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about Al-Hijr, is it from the House (Kaaba), or is there something (else) in it, from the House (Kaaba)?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, not even (the size of) a nail clipping. But, Ismail<sup>as</sup> buried his<sup>as</sup> mother in it, and he<sup>as</sup> disliked that it should be trampled upon. So he<sup>as</sup> built a chamber upon it, and therein are the graves of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 15. Certain individuals of our people have narrated from ibn Jumhur from his father from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Mufaddal ibn ‘Umar who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that Al-Hijr is the house of Isma‘il, and in it Hajar (Hagar) and Isma‘il are buried.”
